release_name: Live TV v5.3.0 (Build 62) — Performance Overhaul & Modular MVC Architecture
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🚀 High-Performance Search & Smooth 60fps Catalog: Added microsecond debounced search and single-fragment DOM batching, eliminating layout thrashing across all 2,989 channels
🏗️ Modular MVC Architecture: Decomposed frontend into clean models, views, and controllers bundled with instant 15ms esbuild
⚡ 0% Idle CPU/GPU Battery Preservation: Closes WebGL AI upscaler, Ambilight canvas, and visualizer requestAnimationFrame loops when player closes
🏎️ Seamless Stream Loading & Race Condition Prevention: Added load sequencers to guarantee glitch-free rapid channel switching
🏍️ SPOTV 2 HD Authentic MotoGP Feed: Restored 1080p 50fps live race coverage with multi-server instant failover
📊 O(1) Telemetry Indexing: Instantaneous match center and live EPG queries with pre-indexed sports telemetry cache
